checks.title: There is a site page, a README image, or a media file to measure
checks.basis: A media lab grades shipped media; with none, there is nothing to grade.

checks.title: Every local file a page or the README references exists
checks.basis: A reference to a missing file shows a broken image or an empty player.

checks.title: No media file is over GitHub's 100 MiB limit
No media file is over the 50 MiB size Git warns about
Each video uses a codec browsers play: H.264, VP8, VP9, or AV1
Each MP4 has its index (moov) at the start, as -movflags +faststart writes it
A video on a page is 20 MB or less
checks.basis: ChudCode's budget: a 30 to 90 second demo encodes well under 20 MB.

checks.title: Each video runs between 5 seconds and 3 minutes
checks.basis: ChudCode's guidance: a demo shorter than 5 s shows nothing, and past 3 minutes few watch to the end.

checks.title: Each video is at least 720 pixels on its short side
checks.basis: ChudCode's guidance, matching the 720-pixel minimum ad platforms ask for.

checks.title: A video that autoplays is muted
A video that autoplays has playsinline
Each video on a page has a poster image
A video with sound has a captions track
Every image has an alt attribute (empty for decoration)
Every local image declares its width and height
A page's first image is not lazy-loaded
No animated GIF is over 5 MB
checks.basis: ChudCode's guidance: a long animated GIF is several times larger than the same clip as H.264 video.

checks.title: The main page sets og:image, so a shared link has a picture
The main page sets og:title, og:type, and og:url
The og:image is an absolute URL to a wide image, about 2:1
A project site has no links starting with /, which leave /<repo>/
Each page loads 5 MB or less before anything is clicked
checks.basis: ChudCode's budget: images, styles, scripts, and any video set to autoplay or preload=auto.
